README.md.text:
# Document workspace
`report.md` contains accepted numbers and analysis. Only prose correction is authorized by the current request.

report.md.text:
# 매출 비교 보고서
A사의 매출은 120 이며 B사의 매출은 100이다. 이 보고서는 같은 기간을 비교하는것이다.
분석 결과와 숫자는 이미 확정됬다. 표현을 자연스럽게 바꾸는 작업만 남았다.

policies.applicability: When changing an API or externally consumed interface with existing compatibility expectations.

item.content: Preserve supported API compatibility or explicitly document and authorize the breaking change.

verification: Check affected callers and compatibility expectations.

policies.applicability: When assessing the validity, assumptions, evidence, or consequences of an argument or decision.

item.content: Identify assumptions, supporting evidence, counterexamples, and consequences relevant to the conclusion.

verification: Distinguish verified facts, inference, and recommendations.

policies.applicability: When comparing company performance using numeric evidence. Exclude translation and proofreading that preserve facts and analysis.

item.content: Compare compatible periods, definitions and denominators, and disclose missing values.

verification: Provide evidence appropriate to the work

policies.applicability: When investigating an unexplained defect or failing behavior and identifying its cause. Exclude requests that only explain already established results.

item.content: Reproduce the failure and test a concrete cause before changing code.

verification: Record reproduction and the check that distinguishes the proposed cause.

policies.applicability: When discovering or clarifying requirements and acceptance criteria for a project or decision.

item.content: Separate outcomes, constraints, and acceptance criteria. Preserve valid existing requirements when adding new ones.

verification: List unresolved ambiguities and explicit changes.

policies.applicability: When organizing knowledge, notes, or source material and preserving provenance and traceability is relevant.

item.content: Keep source provenance and distinguish original material from interpretation.

verification: Check references and traceability of important claims.

policies.applicability: When evaluating or strengthening the ability of tests to detect behavior defects and mutation testing would provide useful evidence.

item.content: Use mutation testing when it helps detect weak behavioral assertions.

verification: Report executed mutations and meaningful survivors when performed.

policies.applicability: When improving internal code structure while preserving observable behavior. Identify separately requested behavior changes instead of calling them refactoring.

item.content: Preserve observable behavior while improving structure. Reclassify intended behavior changes before proceeding.

verification: Compare relevant behavior before and after the refactor.

policies.applicability: When fixing a defect whose recurrence can be checked by a meaningful automated regression test.

item.content: Add a regression check at the layer where the defect occurred.

verification: Show the check detects the original failure.

policies.applicability: When work depends on current, high-stakes, disputed, or uncertain factual claims requiring reliable external evidence. Exclude purely stylistic editing and translation without new factual claims.

item.content: Verify time-sensitive, high-stakes, disputed, and uncertain claims using reliable sources. State remaining uncertainty.

verification: Cite supporting sources and the scope of verification.

policies.applicability: When reviewing an implementation, diff, or API for defects and regressions. Exclude work that merely drafts explanatory prose.

item.content: Review correctness and regressions against accepted requirements. Prioritize actionable findings with evidence.

verification: Link findings to a concrete trigger and affected behavior.

policies.applicability: Only when a material goal, assumption, or decision criterion is unclear and focused questions would advance the task. Exclude clear action requests and straightforward factual questions.

item.content: Ask focused questions only while goals, assumptions, or decision criteria remain materially unclear. Stop when the task is sufficiently defined.

verification: Explain the decision-relevant uncertainty each question resolves.

policies.applicability: When changing testable observable program behavior or fixing a defect. Exclude explanations, documentation-only edits, formatting, and behavior-preserving refactoring.

item.content: Use Red–Green–Refactor for testable behavior changes. Demonstrate the failing test before implementation, then passing tests.

verification: Record the failing-before and passing-after commands and results.

policies.applicability: When drafting or substantively revising a document while preserving accepted requirements and their roles. Exclude code-only changes and mechanical formatting.

item.content: Preserve currently accepted document requirements and their roles. Express the resulting position directly without unnecessary revision-history contrasts.

verification: Check coverage of all active requirements and document quality.

item.content: Preserve all accepted numeric values and analytical conclusions in report.md.

acceptance_criteria: Preserve all accepted numeric values and analytical conclusions in report.md.
